name: Trout
description: The trout is a prized food and game fish from the salmon family. It is known for its tender, pink flesh and its preference for clean, oxygen-rich waters.
habitat: Trout prefer clear, cool and oxygen-rich waters. They live in streams, rivers and cool lakes, often in areas with strong currents.
diet: Predator - feeds on insect larvae, flying insects, crustaceans and smaller fish
features: Adipose fin between dorsal and tail fin
conservation: Varies by subspecies - brook trout partly endangered due to water pollution and river engineering
funFact: Trout have an amazing memory! They can remember feeding spots for months and learn to avoid artificial lures after being caught once.
